findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "check_api_status" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Check whether one AI or developer API provider (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Mistral, Groq, GitHub, Stripe, Cloudflare, Vercel, Supabase, Twilio, ~40 total) is up…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
